observed_anchor: Current CM-08 is OPEN: typed filesystem/process/network/device/FFI effects with receipts, byte-stream values and fail-closed authority are not accepted. The fixed I/O plan requires transport and semantic interpretation to remain distinct.
hypothesis: A small typed host-effect envelope can share authorization/fencing machinery across capability domains if semantic domains remain explicit and are checked fail-closed.
counterhypothesis: A shared envelope flattens domain semantics and becomes a confused-deputy boundary that permits a capability from one host-effect domain to authorize another.

unusual_experiment.name: cross-capability confusion substitution
unusual_experiment.scope: bounded local prototype only; no product or repository runtime mutation
unusual_experiment.baseline: PROCESS EffectRequest generation 7 authorized by PROCESS Capability generation 7
unusual_experiment.intervention: substitute NETWORK Capability generation 7 for the same PROCESS request
unusual_experiment.rollback: ephemeral process exit; no persistent state
unusual_experiment.expected_if_counterhypothesis: cross-domain substitute can ALLOW or domain identity is not enforced

interpretation: Explicit capability-domain equality plus execution-generation equality is sufficient to reject the tested cross-domain substitution in the local reference prototype. This is necessary-style evidence for a shared envelope, not sufficient evidence for production authority, receipts, backend binding, artifact binding, byte-stream semantics, or CM-08 acceptance.
counterevidence_preserved: The experiment does not test same-domain capability confusion, stale-but-equal metadata, forged identifiers, request/receipt replay, backend substitution, TOCTOU, real Linux effects, or product integration.
canonical_frontier_reentry: Do not displace the newer canonical highest-value discriminator. Current workspace selects the smallest canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership+lifetime contract for CM-DATA/CM-VIS/CM-AUDIO, then one provenance-bound opaque-byte ingress through typed/effect IR and the single VM.
next_falsifier: When the Bytes/Buffer contract is selected, bind any host-effect request to explicit domain, execution generation, provenance-bearing byte/buffer identity and durable receipt fields; then test stale/foreign bindings in the real admitted VM path.
